recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key, bright outdoor portrait of a smiling man in a black cowboy hat and suit, featuring a two-tier typographic layout with a chrome-effect script name and a wide-tracked sans-serif title.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's dark hat and jacket contrast against a blown-out white background
Metallic script text overlaps the lower torso of the subject
Secondary block text provides a stable horizontal base for the fluid script above
coreInvariants: Black felt cowboy hat with a structured brim
High-key lighting that eliminates background detail
Chrome or polished steel texture on the primary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up, centered horizontally, with the subject looking slightly off-camera to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and smile serve as the primary focal point, anchored by the dark mass of the hat.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the eyes and smile down to the metallic branding at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space in the background, creating a clean, airy feel.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the subject's clothing and the environment.
paletteRestrictions: Monochromatic grayscale with natural skin tones

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a connected script with a consistent stroke weight
Secondary text uses wide tracking and all-caps geometric forms
Both tiers feature a heavy drop shadow for depth
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended swashes on the initial and final letters of the script name
Double-line inline effect on the script to simulate chrome reflections
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Fluid script paired with rigid, spaced-out geometric sans for structural balance.
graphicDevices: Horizontal divider implied by text alignment

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the base for the connected monoline script
Clean geometric base for the wide-tracked subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key portrait of a man with a beard wearing a black cowboy hat and a black suit jacket over a grey shirt. The background should be a bright, overexposed white outdoor setting with faint architectural outlines like a gazebo. The lighting should be soft on the face.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large metallic chrome script name across the lower chest area with a black outline and drop shadow. Below it, place a subtitle in white all-caps geometric sans-serif with extremely wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the background sufficiently bright/blown out?
Does the script text have a convincing metallic bevel?
Is the tracking on the bottom text wide enough to span the width of the script above?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the hat brim does not cast a harsh shadow over the eyes
Check that the metallic text doesn't blend into the shirt color
Verify the spacing between the two lines of text is consistent
Confirm the high-key background doesn't lose the subject's shoulder edges
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key outdoor portrait + Metallic script display type + Wide-tracked geometric subtitle = Modern Country Aesthetic.
